This suggests that staurosporine could influence EW-7 through microtubule inhibition, a well-documented mode of action in cancer research. The evidence is supported by a chain of targets, but the exact role of each step remains to be fully elucidated. The relationship is plausible, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction between staurosporine and EW-7.
